title: Map state
description: What has changed on one map during play, stored in the campaign save. See docs/design/maps.md section 7.

doors.description: Only doors that differ from their initial state, plus found secret doors. Keyed by door id.

terrain.description: Temporary terrain added during play (a spell, an ability), with source and until.

terrain_on.description: Ids of pack terrain areas that start switched off (active: false) and now apply (the bridge has collapsed).

terrain_off.description: Ids of pack terrain areas that no longer apply (rubble cleared, water drained).

places_found.description: Area maps: GM-only places the party has found in play (shown to players from then on).

polys.description: Closed rings in cell coordinates at 1/8 cell precision. Outer rings and holes use opposite winding.

sky_light.description: Current sky light (outdoor maps and sky regions): bright by day, dim at dusk, dark at night. Default bright.

lights.description: Changes to the map's static lights in play, by id (missing: as the pack gives them): on/off, colour and intensity.

animation.description: How the light moves on the board (drawing only; the rules never change). Presets bring a natural default.

reverse.description: Reverse direction (chroma: the hues turn the other way).

hidden_marks.description: GM-placed hidden markers: creature id -> the square where the party believes it is (shown to players as a ? until the creature is seen).

regions_off.description: Ids of lighting regions that no longer apply (a magical light dispelled).

regions.description: Colour and intensity of lighting regions changed in play, by id (missing: as the pack gives them).

light_animation.description: Light animation on the board for the whole table (drawing only).

on.description: The GM's switch for animated lights.

light_colour.description: Coloured light on the board for the whole table (drawing only).

on.description: The GM's switch for coloured light.

strength.description: Strongest tint, % of full colour (subtle by default).

ambient.description: Ambient sounds on this map, by id (board/sound.js): a loop heard within a radius, muffled through walls that stop sound. Claude places them (tools/sound.mjs).

sound.description: The ambient loop's name in the sound set (sounds.json).

at.description: Where it is, in cells (fractions allowed).

radius.description: How far it is heard, in feet.

inner.description: Heard at full volume within this many feet (default a quarter of the radius, at most 10).

notes.description: Map notes on this map, by id: reminders pinned to a point, written by the player view, the GM view or Claude.

at.description: The exact point the note is pinned to, in cells (fractions allowed).

by.description: Who wrote it: the player view changes its own; the GM view any.

gm_only.description: Shown only in the GM view (default false).

updated.description: When it was written or last changed (ISO time).

templates.description: Area templates placed on this map (bursts, cones, emanations, lines), by id. They stay until removed.

ft.description: Size in feet: radius, length or distance.

width_ft.description: Lines: width in feet (default one square).

by.description: Which view placed it: players remove their own, the GM any.

caster.description: Token id of the creature it comes from (none for a burst placed by Claude at a point).

casterName.description: The caster's public name when it was placed (what players may see).

origin.description: Grid point the area starts from, in cells.

height.description: Feet: a burst's point above the ground, or the caster's elevation for a cone, line or emanation (0 is left out).

dir.description: Cones: direction, 0 north, clockwise in 45-degree steps.

angle.description: Lines: angle in radians, 0 east, clockwise on screen.

tokens.description: Tokens on this map, by generated id (board/ids.js). Positions, names, carried lights and senses are checked here.

name.description: The token's name: a PC's name, an NPC's proper name (never changed), or a unique adjective and the creature's type (Wet-Nosed Rat), never a number.

alias.description: What players see until the party learns the proper name (an adjective and the type: Soot-Skinned Imp).

known.description: The party has learned the proper name: players see the name, not the alias.

hidden.description: Hidden by the GM: players never see it (on the map, in the tracker, its rolls); the GM view draws it transparent.

type.description: What kind of creature (giant-rat): art and stat blocks are looked up by it.

group.description: The encounter set it belongs to (b14-morlocks): letters are unique within a group.

short.description: The letter drawn when the token has no image: the first letter of its adjective (of the alias, else the name).

elevation.description: Height above the ground in feet (negative: below); shown above the token as +15 ft. 0 is left out.

dead.description: Dead: drawn faded with a red cross; no longer blocks movement, sees or can be targeted.

effects.description: Effect badges: the system's conditions (by id) or custom effects (by name), which may name an effect in the content (ref, level). Set by Claude (tools/effect.mjs).

id.description: A condition of the campaign's system (rulesets/<id>/conditions.js).

name.description: A custom effect (a spell, an aura): shown by its first letter.

ref.description: An effect in the content (spell-effects:effect/spell-effect-heroism): its rules change the creature's numbers (tools/effect.mjs apply).

level.description: The level the effect applies at (a spell's rank): @itemLevel in its rules.

duration.description: How long it lasts (engine/time/clock.js): it runs out once its time has passed, at the expiry point of the turn it began in.

start.description: When it began: the clock, and whose turn it was (the creature its duration counts from).

grants.description: Conditions this effect put on the token: they go when it does.

noDecrease.description: A condition that does not go down by itself at the end of the turn (a ruling).

kind.description: Custom effects: the badge's border (conditions take theirs from the system).

detail.description: Extra words shown with it (persistent damage: 2d6 fire).

gm_only.description: Shown only in the GM view.

until.description: When it ends, in words (nothing ends by itself yet).

source.description: Where it came from (Demoralize by Kerra).

light.description: A light the token carries (always a circle). Presets come from the ruleset.

animation.description: How the light moves on the board (drawing only; the rules never change). Presets bring a natural default.

reverse.description: Reverse direction (chroma: the hues turn the other way).

senses.description: Senses beyond normal vision as the ruleset names them (low-light, darkvision, greater-darkvision), optionally with a range in feet; a temporary one (a spell) gives its source.
